pages.title: Blopens Fashion Designer
pages.description: Blopens Fashion Designer - Kids love BLOPENS as they can easily create fantastic pictures with amazing effects! Shop online or instores
pages.ld_description:
Includes: 20 colouring templates, 20 reusable stencils, 10 duo mini Blo Pens, 1  magic colour change mini Blo Pens, sticker sheet, sparkly gems.
 	Over 1,000 different fashion design combinations!
 	Choose from different hair styles, tops, bottoms, shoes and purses and use the Blo Pens to create your fashion design.
 	Ages 6+ years.
